description: This file contains an abstract class 'RelationalStorageTests' which provides shared testing functionality for relational storage back-ends in an Orleans-based project. It includes setup routines, test methods for read/write operations, exception handling, and serialization tests, using dependencies like dependency injection, storage utilities, and grain state handling.

classes.name: RelationalStorageTests
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common testing procedures for relational storage back-ends, including operations such as read/write, hash collision, and exception handling for Orleans storage implementations.

methods.name: Relational_WriteReadWriteRead100StatesInParallel
methods.description: Tests writing and reading 100 states in parallel to the storage.

methods.name: Relational_HashCollisionTests
methods.description: Performs hash collision tests by configuring a constant hasher and executing parallel storage tests.

methods.name: Relational_WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Verifies that writing a duplicate record fails with an appropriate exception message.

methods.name: Relational_WriteInconsistentFailsWithIncosistentStateException
methods.description: Checks that an inconsistent state write fails as expected and throws the correct exception message.

methods.name: Relational_Json_WriteRead
methods.description: Performs a write/read test with JSON serialization for a given grain type and id.

methods.name: Relational_Binary_WriteRead
methods.description: Performs a write/read test with binary serialization for a given grain type and id.

methods.name: GetJsonGrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve the JSON serializer instance.

methods.name: GetOrleansGrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve the Orleans serializer instance.
